decisions.detail: All originals in `user_supplied_input_files/` with `input_files_manifest.csv`. GNPS2 connector not available; files pulled from gnps2.org. Library search output downloaded but NOT used (user's `eb_curated_annotations_MSV000082221.tsv` used). Qiita metadata `11546_..._metadata.txt` (same MSV folder) used for surgery fields.

Exposure = `has_surgery` y vs n (prior surgery). Initial = baseline CD Welch test; over time = log2 ~ surgery x month + (1/subject) mixed model (all CD samples) + per-time-point Welch tests. Primary = CD (193 samples, 75 people). UC descriptive only (7 baseline surgery samples, 5 people, all colectomy+pouch).
324 of 334 study injections linked (`PLCL<id>` = Qiita `anonymized_name`). 10 unlinked excluded.
Raw peak areas, gap-filled.

Sulfadimethoxine (resuspension): intact, feature 79, 332/334 samples. Sulfamethazine (extraction): feature 253 RT 2.60, 56/334 samples, 11/11 std mixes; essentially absent from samples. Metadata lists other standards (sulfamethizole, sulfachloropyridazine); not used.
166 candidate pairs (5 ppm, 0.1 min); 10 spectra-supported review pairs, 139 review, 17 do not merge. No XIC available. Merge map empty.
No pooled QCs. Four plates; plate-adjusted baseline model agrees (r=0.997).
Mean(324 study samples) / mean(33 solvent blanks) >= 5. 1,183 fail.
Detected in >= 20% of samples in at least one CD surgery group (all time points). 11,242 retained.
status: run. Recommended and applied: sum (TIC) over the retained features, scaled to the median. rCLR sensitivity. IS normalization not applied (user).
Zero -> half minimum positive normalized value per feature, log2.
Same samples, factors, imputation; max abs diff of retained values = 0. Separate unfiltered-family q.
Samples counted: 193 CD.
2,928 nodes, 4,629 edges, 524 families, 5,964 singletons (nodes + singletons = 8,892 MS/MS features).
193 of 1,246 annotated unclassified (list provided).
2 CD samples (T2 > 99.9%) kept.

Welch t, OLS adjusted (sex, steroid, TNF inhibitor, antibiotics, immunomodulator), MixedLM REML, PLS-DA (5-fold CV, 200 permutations), PERMANOVA-style R2. BH within filtered family; separate unfiltered family. Volcano cutoff raw p < 0.05 and abs(log2FC) >= 0.58.
411 flagged; awaiting user decision.
`MSV000082221_part1_report_v1.pdf`

Of 411 flagged in v1: 344 were removed by the prevalence filter only; 67 involved the blank filter (kept out, as instructed). Contaminants and additives class: 0 of the 344. 223 of the 344 have zero CD detections (not testable) and were held out; 121 added back.

Rescued features analyzed as a separate family (selected on signal, optimistic p). Primary q (11,242) unchanged. Per-feature table has q_rescued_family and q_combined_family. Normalization factors, PCA, PLS-DA not recomputed.

1,481 features with fewer than 3 CD detections have constant imputed CD values; v1 reported spurious mixed-model p-values and unfiltered-family q for them (flag list: 224 of 411 affected; unfiltered-family baseline q<0.05: 2,222 in v1, 1,270 corrected). v2 sets their CD tests to missing (`testable_CD` = false). Primary results unaffected.
193 of 1,246 left unclassified.
Not run.
6,907 retained features with at least 50% imputed CD values and at least 3 detections. Fisher exact (baseline), detected-only Welch, GEE logistic over time.
Baseline CD: none 39, ileocolonic 19, colectomy 11; 2 samples excluded (partial colectomy; surgery_type none). Welch on 11,242 primary features.
`MSV000082221_part1_report_v2.pdf`

The 121 added-back features (flagged, prevalence-only, testable in CD, not contaminants) are merged into the primary family. Final primary family = 11,363 features (11,242 + 121). Column `origin` in `per_feature_results_v3.csv` = `v1_primary` or `added_back_v2`.

BH q recomputed within the 11,363 features for every test (columns `*_q_filtered`). Baseline q < 0.05: 1,552 (v1, v2) -> 1,540. Only 4 of the 121 added-back features keep baseline q < 0.05 in the merged family (v2's separate-family q of 121 of 121 was misleading).

TIC factors recomputed on the 11,363 final features; same factors applied to the unfiltered table (max |log2 change| in any sample 0.04, median 0.0006). Normalization comparison (Section 7) not rerun (run on the 11,242-feature set).

Zero imputation, Welch, adjusted OLS, mixed models, rCLR sensitivity, PCA, PLS-DA, PERMANOVA-style drivers, plate-adjusted model, network node/class tables and volcano figures, presence/absence (Fisher, GEE), surgery-type stratification.
Features with fewer than 3 CD detections (1,481) have CD test results set to missing; unfiltered-family q recomputed. 223 flagged zero-detection features held out (not testable).
13,407 features removed; 66 remain flagged (30 exploratory baseline signal, 37 annotated removed by the blank filter, 0 mixed-model-only). None re-added beyond the 121.
`MSV000082221_part1_report_v3.pdf`
Time and plate are confounded (month R2 on plate 0.59; VIF 2.5; SE of time slope x1.55). The Part 1 v3 and the first Part 2 statements ("plate artifacts") are replaced by "inconclusive".
26 people, 54 samples, 27 person-plate pairs; no feature slope at q<0.05.
Surgery effect month 0 q<0.05: 3,370 features; no-surgery slope 5; interaction 6.
Standard mixes and the resuspension standard are stable across plates.
`MSV000082221_part1_addendum_v4.pdf`; Part 1 v3 files unchanged.

patterns.title: Primary and conjugated bile acids (CA, CDCA, UDCA/muricholic, Gly/Tau and amino-acid conjugates) higher in surgery
patterns.meaning: Bile-acid malabsorption signature (primary and conjugated bile acids reach stool), stronger with ileocolonic resection

patterns.title: Secondary bile acids (DCA- and LCA-based) do not rise with the primary bile acids
patterns.meaning: Secondary (colon-microbial) bile acids not rising with primary ones; reduced 7-dehydroxylation is possible but not shown

patterns.title: Urobilinoids (urobilin, stercobilin) and their molecular family (F10) lower in surgery
patterns.meaning: Fewer microbial bilirubin-reduction products (urobilinoids), stronger without a colon

patterns.title: Heme/porphyrin-related features (family F13 and bilirubin/biliverdin/hemin annotations)
patterns.meaning: Heme/porphyrin features lower; direction mixed, not specific vs matched background

patterns.title: Acylcarnitines and the lauroylcarnitine family (F99) higher in surgery
patterns.meaning: Fatty-acid carnitine esters in stool, stronger without a colon

patterns.title: Lysophospholipids and glycerolipids (families F23, F156, F128) higher in surgery
patterns.meaning: Lysophospholipids and glycerolipids higher, mostly when the colon is absent

patterns.title: N-acyl amides of amino acids and amines (N-oleoyl leucine F95, N-acyl tyramines F117, N-acyl putrescines F159) higher in surgery
patterns.meaning: Microbial or host N-acyl amides higher, mostly with partial resection

patterns.title: Fatty acids and fatty-acid esters, incl. long-chain acyl lipids, higher in surgery
patterns.meaning: Fatty acids/esters modestly higher

patterns.title: Oxylipins lower in surgery
patterns.meaning: Oxylipins lower but within the general shift

patterns.title: Di- and tripeptides lower in surgery
patterns.meaning: Peptides lower, same size as the global shift

patterns.title: Amino acids, N-acetyl amino acids and indole/tryptophan metabolites lower in surgery
patterns.meaning: Amino-acid and tryptophan-pathway features lower, same size as the global shift

patterns.title: Tyr-containing conjugates lower, Phe-containing conjugates higher (opposite directions)
patterns.meaning: Tyr conjugates down, Phe conjugates up; small groups

patterns.title: Amine-carbonyl adduct families (F47, F61) from the synthetic-library annotations
patterns.meaning: Synthetic-library annotations; probably not true biology

patterns.title: Flavonoids and isoflavones (genistein/daidzein family F16, naringenin family F146) higher in surgery
patterns.meaning: Dietary flavonoids/isoflavones higher

patterns.title: Other plant/diet families (piperine F35, xanthones F49, curcuminoids F11, terpenoids)
patterns.meaning: Mixed direction; rarely detected

patterns.title: Vitamins/cofactors and steroidal alkaloids lower in surgery
patterns.meaning: Vitamin/alkaloid features lower within the general shift

patterns.title: Medication families higher in surgery (amoxicillin F37, opioids F46, sildenafil F57, pantoprazole F143, valsartan F32, mycophenolate F105, cathinone F199)
patterns.meaning: Medication or exposure families higher in surgery (opioid, antibiotic, PPI, immunosuppressant)

patterns.title: Medication families lower in surgery (PPIs F21, cetirizine F60, quinidine F31, cortisone F84, sotalol F36, trazodone F123, atorvastatin F34, quinoline F106)
patterns.meaning: Other medication families lower in surgery

patterns.title: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) series lower in surgery (families F2, F12, F42, F15, F6)
patterns.meaning: Polyethylene glycol (laxative, excipient or collection-material) signal much lower in surgery

patterns.title: Families of unannotated or putative-conjugate features lower in surgery
patterns.meaning: Unannotated and putative-conjugate families lower, many linked to bile pigments, PEG or drugs

patterns.title: Families of unannotated features higher in surgery (F83, F147, F172, F7 part)
patterns.meaning: Unannotated families higher in surgery

patterns.title: Overall lower detection and signal in surgery (all features, unannotated, singletons)
patterns.meaning: Lower overall detection in surgery (already reported as lower metabolome diversity)

patterns.title: No-surgery group: nearly all features rise over time (527 of 538 q<0.05 rise before plate adjustment); time is confounded with plate (run order vs month rho 0.73)
patterns.meaning: Unresolved: plate adjustment leaves 5 features; slopes not distinguishable from plate or batch

patterns.title: Surgery x time interaction (16 features; 15 negative slopes) follows the same plate-confounded rise
patterns.meaning: Unresolved: interaction falls from 16 to 6 features after plate adjustment, inconclusive

patterns.title: Colon presence and ileocecal valve removal explain as much or more variance than has_surgery (colon_present R2 6.1% vs surgery 4.5% at baseline)
patterns.meaning: Points to anatomy (ileal loss vs colon loss) as the driver; surgery label is a proxy

patterns.title: Ileocolonic vs colectomy differ for 151 features (q<0.05): bile acids and N-acyl amides lean ileocolonic; lysophospholipids and acylcarnitines lean colectomy
patterns.meaning: Separates ileal-loss from colon-loss effects

patterns.title: Presence-only differences: 600 of 752 baseline-significant features (in the high-imputed set) differ in detection, not abundance
patterns.meaning: Detection vs true absence cannot be separated here

patterns.title: Annotated features removed by prevalence: drugs/agrochemicals 58%, contaminants 57%, diet 43%; retained-only class means understate drug and PEG effects
patterns.meaning: Unfiltered class means: PEG -0.86 vs -1.33 retained; drugs lower-group -0.78 vs -1.06

patterns.title: 37 annotated features removed by the blank filter (11 lipids, 7 contaminants, 5 drugs, 5 diet); none significant at baseline
patterns.meaning: Blank-filter losses show no surgery signal

patterns.title: 14 removed features detected in only one surgery group (11 only in no-surgery); all unannotated
patterns.meaning: Too rare to interpret

patterns.title: 703 robust unannotated MS/MS features (q<0.05, robust); 77 have an annotated neighbor (e.g. m/z 358.2599 up +3.95 next to a lauroylcarnitine-related node by C2H4)
patterns.meaning: Annotated neighbors give chemical context; identities unconfirmed

patterns.title: Cortisone-acetate-related family F84 is lower in surgery and lower in current steroid users (raw p 0.004) although steroid use is more common in surgery (29% vs 22%)
patterns.meaning: Opposite to the expected direction; needs checking

patterns.title: Annotated features shift less than detection-matched unannotated features (annotated mean log2FC -0.14 vs -0.30)
patterns.meaning: Annotation bias toward abundant, widely detected classes

hypotheses.title: Anatomy-graded bile-acid pool (ileal loss raises primary/conjugated bile acids; colon loss lowers secondary)
hypotheses.state: PROPOSED (refined in v3: bile acids track small-bowel resection extent; secondary bile acids also rise with it)
hypotheses.evidence: [primary bile acids +0.57 log2 (153 features), ileocolonic +1.06, matched-background p<0.001, plate-adjusted +0.60, antibiotic-adjusted +0.73; secondary -0.36 plate-adjusted; small-bowel resection +0.29 (primary, p 0.017) and +0.32 (secondary, p 0.003); balance score A baseline Cliff delta 0.49, p 0.0004]
hypotheses.literature: ["[1] summary only (supports)", "[2] summary only (contradicts secondary direction)"]
hypotheses.next_investigation: metagenomic bai-operon genes; ileal status model; sample-level secondary/primary ratio
hypotheses.additional_analysis: {proposed: true, approved: true, performed: [surgery-type mixed model, plate and antibiotic adjustment], result: effects unchanged}

hypotheses.title: Colon loss or bypass lowers bilirubin-reducing microbes and urobilinoids
hypotheses.evidence: [47 of 51 features lower, -1.34 log2; ileostomy -2.55, J-pouch -2.02, ileorectal -0.61; antibiotic effect -0.88; score tracks detection rho 0.56]
hypotheses.literature: ["[4] summary only", "[5] summary only (antibiotic classes differ)", "[7] summary only"]
hypotheses.next_investigation: BilR gene counts; authentic standards and MS/MS

hypotheses.title: Lauroylcarnitine marks epithelial lipid stress after surgery
hypotheses.evidence: [lauroylcarnitine +2.7 log2 (q 0.011); palmitoyl-, acetyl-, free carnitine flat]
hypotheses.literature: ["[6] summary only (class-wide IBD elevation; no surgery data)"]
hypotheses.next_investigation: within-person series with mucosal healing; authentic standard

hypotheses.title: Chain-length-selective N-acyl amide production changes after ileocolonic resection
hypotheses.evidence: [C18 amides higher (N-oleoyl leucine +1.3), C4 amides lower; ileocolonic +0.68, others negative]
hypotheses.literature: ["[9] summary only (bacterial N-acyl amides exist; no surgery or chain-length data)"]

hypotheses.title: Over-time change in the surgery difference
hypotheses.evidence: [unadjusted slopes 538, interaction 16; plate-adjusted 5 and 6; within-plate 0 features at q<0.05; time and plate confounded]

hypotheses.title: Pouch-related patterns replicate in UC J-pouch
hypotheses.evidence: [UC J-pouch vs none correlates with CD J-pouch (Spearman 0.72, 666 pattern features); bile acids +0.53 vs +0.49; urobilinoids -1.79 vs -2.02; features detected -0.36 log2 (p<0.001); PEG and N-acyl amides do not replicate]
hypotheses.alternatives: [only 5 UC surgery people, all J-pouch; plate 1 holds 7 of 16 UC surgery samples]
hypotheses.additional_analysis: {proposed: true, approved: true, performed: [UC J-pouch vs UC no surgery mixed model compared with CD J-pouch], result: patterns follow the pouch, not the disease}

hypotheses.title: Disease activity and medications do not explain the surgery patterns
hypotheses.evidence: [adjusting for physician global assessment, TNF inhibitor, steroid, immunomodulator, integrin inhibitor and antibiotics leaves surgery effects unchanged (P3 -0.550 to -0.505; P1 +0.217 to +0.231); endoscopic activity and global assessment have no effect]
hypotheses.alternatives: [activity may follow surgery (over-adjustment), partly missing records]
hypotheses.additional_analysis: {proposed: true, approved: true, performed: [mixed-model adjustment, ileal vs colon model, bile-acid balance score], result: effects unchanged; anatomy terms collinear (VIF up to 9.9)}
